hook.say: America's ten most visited national parks, ranked. Number one gets more than double number two!

outro.say: Which park is your favorite? Comment below!

items.name: Glacier
items.say: Number ten: Glacier, the Crown of the Continent. Three-point-one million visits.
items.cap: Number ten: Glacier, the Crown of the Continent. 3.1 million visits.

items.name: Olympic
items.say: Nine: Olympic, with rainforest, glaciers and coast. Three-point-six million visits.
items.cap: Nine: Olympic, with rainforest, glaciers and coast. 3.6 million visits.

items.name: Grand Teton
items.say: Eight: Grand Teton, right next to Yellowstone. Three-point-eight million visits.
items.cap: Eight: Grand Teton, right next to Yellowstone. 3.8 million visits.

items.name: Acadia
items.say: Seven: Acadia, famous for America's first sunrise. Four-point-one million visits.
items.cap: Seven: Acadia, famous for America's first sunrise. 4.1 million visits.

items.name: Rocky Mountain
items.say: Six: Rocky Mountain, with a road above twelve thousand feet. Four-point-two million visits.
items.cap: Six: Rocky Mountain, with a road above twelve thousand feet. 4.2 million visits.

items.name: Yosemite
items.say: Five: Yosemite, home of El Capitan. Four-point-three million visits.
items.cap: Five: Yosemite, home of El Capitan. 4.3 million visits.

items.name: Grand Canyon
items.say: Four: Grand Canyon, a full mile deep. Four-point-four million visits.
items.cap: Four: Grand Canyon, a full mile deep. 4.4 million visits.

items.name: Yellowstone
items.say: Three: Yellowstone, the world's first national park. Four-point-eight million visits.
items.cap: Three: Yellowstone, the world's first national park. 4.8 million visits.

items.name: Zion
items.say: Two: Zion, Utah's red rock canyon. Nearly 5 million visits.
items.cap: Two: Zion, Utah's red rock canyon. Nearly 5 million visits.

items.name: Great Smoky Mountains
items.say: And number one: the Great Smoky Mountains! Eleven-point-five million visits, and it's free to enter.
items.cap: And number one: the Great Smoky Mountains! 11.5 million visits, and it's free to enter.
